verdict.rationale: Otter does have a Public API for Enterprise workspaces, so this question applies. However, the help-center evidence says the API is documented only as a prose article with static examples. It states that no machine-readable spec is published: api.otter.ai/openapi.json returns 404, and there is no interactive reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
